title: lem-sc-p1-tor-kernel-boundary-naturality-of
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, M an R-module, and δ a family assigning to every surjective R-linear map q:F → N an R-linear map δ_q : Tor₁^R(N,M) → ker(q) ⊗_R M. Assume each pair (Tor₁(q,M),δ_q) and (δ_q, ker(q) inclusion ⊗ 1_M) is exact. For commuting squares of surjections q,q′ with maps a,b and a kernel map c compatible with the inclusions, δ_{q′} ∘ Tor₁(b,M) = (c ⊗ 1_M) ∘ δ_q.

source.place: Section 00LY, Tags 00M0 (Tor exact sequence), 00LZ (resolution functoriality), 00M3 (Tor symmetry); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00LY

proof.text: Lift each compatible square of short exact kernel sequences to a morphism between the chosen degreewise split free resolutions. Naturality of the homology connecting morphism, together with the Tor and tensor augmentation identifications, yields the displayed equality; the exactness hypothesis is carried along from the family δ.

theorem tor_kernel_boundary_naturality_of
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{u} R)
    (δ : ∀ (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N),
      Function.Surjective q →
        (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).obj N).obj M) →ₗ[R]
          (LinearMap.ker q ⊗[R] M)) :
    (∀ (F N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (hq : Function.Surjective q),
      Function.Exact (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom q)).app M).hom (δ F N q hq) ∧
      Function.Exact (δ F N q hq) ((LinearMap.ker q).subtype.rTensor M)) →
    ∀ (F N F' N' : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : F →ₗ[R] N) (q' : F' →ₗ[R] N')
        (hq : Function.Surjective q) (hq' : Function.Surjective q')
        (a : F →ₗ[R] F') (b : N →ₗ[R] N')
        (c : LinearMap.ker q →ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker q'),
      q'.comp a = b.comp q →
      (∀ x : LinearMap.ker q, (c x : F') = a (x : F)) →
      ∀ t : (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).obj N).obj M),
        δ F' N' q' hq' ((((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) 1).map
          (ModuleCat.ofHom b)).app M).hom t) =
        c.rTensor M (δ F N q hq t)
